title: query_agent transient error recovery missing from run.skill.md
description: When query_agent returns a transient error (429 quota exceeded, timeout), the skill provides no guidance for retry or fallback. In run e1e59193, query_agent failed at Step 2 with OpenAI 429, causing the implementing agent to treat all versions as null and make no changes. The spec's primary intent (upgrading action pins) was not accomplished. A recovery instruction would reduce end_review_error_count and prevent future zero-output runs.
proposed_resolution: Add a Phase 2 sub-step to run.skill.md: if query_agent returns an error rather than the expected JSON, retry once; if retry also fails, fall back to using the implementing agent's own training knowledge with an explicit signal noting the fallback.
